_doc: Registry of the cloud-me-pub-profiles hub. A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (_git-repos-master), narrowed to the cloud-me-pub-profiles family (company and profile sites). Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container - see clone.sh for the clone/link model.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.
